run_train_sana_sprint: run the Sana Sprint training script with pretrained model, dataset parquet files, and output directory
create_dataset_text2image: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads text-image pairs from a HuggingFace dataset for text-to-image generation
build_discriminator_heads: build a multi-scale Sana Sprint discriminator with spectral normalization heads on transformer blocks
test_validation_pipeline: test the trained Sana Sprint model by running validation inference and logging generated images
save_model_card_hub: save a model card with validation images and upload the trained Sana Sprint weights to the HuggingFace Hub
